description:
Please provide a formal quote in addition to a completed solicitation (N4523A-26-Q-4022) via email to andrew.r.smith6@navy.mil 

or andrew.r.smith7.civ@usnavy.mil

- Items must be Mercury free.

- Payment will be made by NET 30, after the items have been received

by the Navy.

- Please provide the name of the manufacturer, and its country of origin.

*** With pricing, please include the cost of shipping to Bremerton, WA. ***

                            ** Do not price shipping separately. **

                                     * Shipping; FOB Destination. *

*Inspection Code E. The Navy has 7 days to inspect the item before payment

is made.*
